browser.expect: Glass browser tabs and toolbar adopt the wallpaper surface; the Windows titlebar strip is clear. Standard theme chrome and document canvases remain opaque.

titlebar.expect: The pinned and peeking sidebar has one continuous tint through the titlebar; viewport modal dimming is applied once, with native window controls undimmed.

sidebar.expect: The footer fade is hidden only for glass themes. Standard themes retain the fade and switching back restores it.
